# azureadb2c_trust_framework_key_set (Data Source)

Reads one Azure AD B2C policy key container (key set). Key material is never read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "azureadb2c_trust_framework_key_set" "token_signing" {
  id = "B2C_1A_TokenSigningKeyContainer"
}

output "token_signing_key_id" {
  value = data.azureadb2c_trust_framework_key_set.token_signing.key_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Container name including the B2C_1A_ prefix.

### Read-Only

- `key_id` (String) Key id (kid) of the active key. Null when the container has no key.
- `key_type` (String) Type of the active key: RSA or oct. Null when the container has no key.
- `use` (String) Usage of the active key: sig or enc. Null when the container has no key.
